initialExam.title: NPCIL Executive Trainee 2026
initialExam.conductingBody: Nuclear Power Corporation of India Limited
initialExam.description: NPCIL recruits Executive Trainees through GATE 2024/2025/2026 score for nuclear power plant engineering and operations across India. 330 vacancies notified.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E./B.Tech with minimum 60% marks in notified engineering disciplines. Valid GATE 2024/2025/2026 score.
initialExam.qualifications: B.E./B.Tech with 60% marks + valid GATE score
initialExam.syllabus: Based on GATE syllabus of respective engineering discipline. Interview covers domain knowledge and aptitude.
initialExam.examPattern: GATE Score based shortlisting → Personal Interview.
initialExam.selectionProcess: GATE Score Shortlisting → Interview → Medical → Final Selection
initialExam.jobRole: Executive Trainee in nuclear power plant operations, maintenance, and engineering
initialExam.careerGrowth: Executive Trainee → Scientific Officer → Senior SO → Manager → DGM → GM → ED → CMD.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit npcilcareers.co.in 2. Register 3. Apply with GATE score 4. Upload documents 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: Pay Level 10 (7th CPC). CTC approx. ₹13.5 LPA initially

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Subsidized township accommodation, LTC, Superannuation, Performance Related Pay

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
